request.query: For finitely many positive real weights a_i and epsilon>0, choose arbitrarily large natural integers n_i whose products n_i*a_i lie between a common scale and (1+epsilon) times it.

items.name: Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (w z : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) → ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1 → (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) → ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i

items.name: Multipliable.eventually_bounded_finset_prod
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {v : ι → ℝ}, Multipliable v → ∃ r₁ > 0, ∃ s₁, ∀ (t : Finset ι), s₁ ⊆ t → ∏ i ∈ t, v i ≤ r₁

items.name: controlled_prod_of_mem_closure
items.type:
∀ {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedCommGroup E] {a : E} {s : Subgroup E},
  a ∈ closure ↑s →
    ∀ {b : ℕ → ℝ},
      (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < b n) →
        ∃ v,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), v i) Filter.atTop (nhds a) ∧
            (∀ (n : ℕ), v n ∈ s) ∧ ‖v 0 / a‖ < b 0 ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ‖v n‖ < b n

items.name: NNReal.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (w z : ι → NNReal), ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1 → ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ ↑(w i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i

items.name: Real.geom_mean_lt_arith_mean_weighted_iff_of_pos
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (w z : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < w i) →
    ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1 → (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) → (∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i < ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i ↔ ∃ j ∈ s, ∃ k ∈ s, z j ≠ z k)

items.name: Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean4_weighted
items.type:
∀ {w₁ w₂ w₃ w₄ p₁ p₂ p₃ p₄ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ w₁ →
    0 ≤ w₂ →
      0 ≤ w₃ →
        0 ≤ w₄ →
          0 ≤ p₁ →
            0 ≤ p₂ →
              0 ≤ p₃ →
                0 ≤ p₄ →
                  w₁ + w₂ + w₃ + w₄ = 1 → p₁ ^ w₁ * p₂ ^ w₂ * p₃ ^ w₃ * p₄ ^ w₄ ≤ w₁ * p₁ + w₂ * p₂ + w₃ * p₃ + w₄ * p₄
